assets.caption: Definitions table — piping terminology (Connector through Slip Blind or Spacer)

cells.value: The term "connector" shall mean dimensionally interchangeable mechanical connectors (e.g., Grayloc or Techlok).
The term "fitting" both buttweld and socket weld fittings.
The term "flanges" designed to ASME B16.5, ASME B16.47, MSS SP-44, or API Spec 6A Type 6B, or special requirements (for flanges beyond the referenced ratings).
The term "forge fitting" billet section forged through heating and controlled compression between a set of forging dies, and includes socket welded fittings as well as branch connections.
The term "item" shall refer to fittings, flanges, slip blinds, spacers, and connectors, collectively.
A lot is defined as all items made from the same heat of steel and heat treatment batch.
Blinds or spacers intended to be installed between flanges and rest entirely within the flange bolt circle.
